apps.name: Manic EMU v2.0.1
apps.subtitle: Love Retro Games
apps.localizedDescription:
Manic EMU is an all-in-one retro emulator for iPhone and iPad. Console, handheld, arcade, computer, and mobile classics live in one library. The app does not include games, BIOS, or game data. Use only legally owned backups, homebrew, or public-domain software.

Supported Platforms

Nintendo
- Nintendo 3DS (3DS)
- Nintendo GameCube (NGC)
- Nintendo Wii (Wii)
- Nintendo 64 (N64)
- Nintendo DS (NDS)
- Game Boy Advance (GBA)
- Game Boy Color (GBC)
- Game Boy (GB)
- Nintendo Entertainment System (NES)
- Famicom Disk System (FDS)
- Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES)
- Virtual Boy (VB)
- Pokemon Mini (PM)

Sony
- PlayStation (PS1)
- PlayStation Portable (PSP)

Sega
- Dreamcast (DC)
- Sega Saturn (SS)
- Sega Master System (MS)
- Game Gear (GG)
- SG-1000 (SG)
- Sega Genesis 32X (32X)
- Sega CD / Mega-CD (MCD)
- Sega Genesis / Mega Drive (MD)

NEC
- PC Engine (PCE)
- TurboGrafx-16 (TG-16)
- TurboGrafx-CD (TG-CD)
- SuperGrafx (SGX)

SNK
- Neo Geo Pocket (NGP)
- Neo Geo Pocket Color (NGPC)

Atari
- Atari 2600
- Atari 5200
- Atari 7800
- Atari Jaguar
- Atari Lynx

Commodore
- Commodore 64 (C64)
- Amiga

Other
- Arcade
- DOOM
- MS-DOS
- Java ME (J2ME)
- Symbian

More systems are planned.

[RetroAchievements]
- Challenge players worldwide and light up trophies that are yours
- Multiset: grind multiple sets on one game — earn subset trophies without patching
- Hardcore Mode: tougher rules, trophies that actually count

[Save States, Your Way]
- Unlimited manual save states plus 50 auto slots
- Save Manager: browse by time, compare, and restore in one tap

[Speed, Cheats & Shortcuts]
- 5x fast forward — you set the pace
- Cheats on demand from an online library
- Custom shortcuts for save, speed, and screenshots

[Filters, Skins & Screenshots]
- Retro filters from our exclusive library
- Skins that feel like real hardware, third-party skins welcome, flex layouts that fit your hands
- Screenshots for the highlight reel

[Landscape Library]
- Landscape console mode — library, covers, and shortcuts on one screen
- Background music and navigation sounds — browsing feels like an arcade
- Browse with a controller or keyboard — stay on the couch

[Play Together]
- Local multiplayer whenever you want
- Eligible cores can host rooms, scan LAN, connect over relay, and spectate

[Cloud Import in One Step]
- Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Baidu Cloud, Aliyun
- WebDAV and SMB too — bring the whole library over in one go

[Controllers Your Way]
- Native Joy-Con, DualShock, and Xbox support
- Bluetooth controllers and keyboards — play on Mac too
- Multiple controllers at once, solo or a full party

[AirPlay — Living Room Ready]
- AirPlay to a TV or display
- Phone to TV without a hitch — couch nights and hangouts
- Big screen plus a controller — immersion maxed out

versions.localizedDescription:
- Added WonderSwan support
- Added NAOMI, Atomiswave, and System SP arcade support
- Added Flash support
  · Skin button binding
  · Hardware keyboard input
  · Software keyboard input
  · Touch input
- Built-in, self-contained JIT — no external debugger required
- Added Slow Motion
- Improved GameCube and Wii performance
- GameCube now supports multi-disc games
- Improved Wii motion controls
- Simulate the Wii IR pointer by touch
- Add games from other emulators via a link
- Fixed some arcade systems that wouldn’t run
- Fixed Dreamcast games running too fast
- Fixed PSP crashes
- Added NDS lid open/close
- Improved rotation: with orientation lock on in Control Center, the app no longer snaps back to portrait
- In-game shortcut tips can now be turned off
- Landscape library can disable carousel style
- Smoother landscape carousel scrolling
- MultiDisc Helper supports more formats
- Hardware keyboard input for Symbian, Amiga, and C64
- Added RomM support
  · LAN self-hosted servers only
  · Sync only for games imported from RomM
  · Manual sync only, from the service card’s long-press menu
  · Pull ROMs, covers, metadata, manuals, and game saves
- Fixed a launch timeout that could quit the app on older devices
- N64 now supports ROMs larger than 64 MB

apps.name: Twitter
apps.subtitle: NeoFreeBird version 6.7.1
apps.localizedDescription: NeoFreeBird-BHTwitter, changed to look like the app before the rebrand.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Added option to hide Message button on tweets
- Updated X to 12.28.1
- Removed the “Try Grok Bot” button

New Features
- Updated X to 12.26 (adds scheduled tweets, not my work though)
- Added ability to use Tenor GIFs instead of GIPHY
- Added option to always download the highest-quality MP4 file from media downloads
- Added option to stop X from losing focus when staying out of the app for a long time

Fixes
- Fixed Japanese and Russian localizations
- Fixed the theme color not showing on horizontal scroll bars
- Fixed the Twitter icon in the top-left corner not tinting on iPad

Version 6.6.1

Fixes
- Fixed voice message downloading (now requires 2 fingers with a long press)
- Fixed a crash that would happen when encountering any confirmation prompt

New Features
- Updated X to 12.21
- Added ability to remove retweets of tweets from users who’ve blocked you
- Doomscrolling can now be turned off with disabling video scroll

**Fixes**
- Fixed X branding in newer versions
- Added Turkish, Japanese, and Spanish localizations

Known Issues
- Downloading voice messages and bypassing screenshot detection are broken, will be fixed soon™.

New Features
- Added option to disable the new media carousel (switches back to old grid view)

Fixes
- Fixed the “Confirm Follow” feature
- Added more Japanese translations (thank you @so-5699)
- Changed tap to pause to use 2 fingers instead of one (this now allows you to dismiss the media view)
- The in-app browser is off by default in LiveContainer installs (thank you @PeekPerformer)
- Fixed a hang on first startup in LiveContainer installs (thank you @PeekPerformer)

Updated X to 12.15

New Features
- Added option to see where an account is located in a tweet. Can spillover into next line at times
- Added option to disable screenshot detection in XChat

Fixes
- Fixes the “Restore Video Timestamp” option to prevent crashing on newer versions (fixes #23)
- Added back the theme color to the horizontal scroll bar (fixes #27)
- Forced the “more” bar to always be present (this was only an iPad issue)
- Fixed the video timestamp not reflecting the custom font
- Moved “Copy Profile Info” to the profile overflow menu. This now means you can’t copy profile info from your own profile, but you can click “Edit profile” and get that, so not a massive loss
- Fixed bookmarked posts from verified accounts not followed not showing when the option to hide verified tweets was on

Version 6.4.0

New Features
- Added option to download voice messages (due to how XChat encrypts attachments, you need to play the message to have the option to download it)
- Added ability to upload in 1080p (and 4k, but this is technically unsupported)
- Added option to see poll results before voting
- Added option to tap to play/pause video (video controls can’t be hidden with this option on, Twitter limitation)

Fixes
- Fixes the black launch screen and now shows it as blue the whole way through. There is an option to toggle it back to black.

New Features
- Added option to directly copy user URL
- Added option to hide the “typing” indicator in Chat
- Added a toggle to show unrounded counts, as well as added the ability to show the unrounded number of tweets
- The News tab is now hidden
- Added an option to disable the gesture to dock videos

Fixes
- Fixed tab labels being off-center
- Fixed the “Restore Video Timestamp” option
- Tinted some buttons in the Chat menu 
- Fixed the news button not being rebranded

Tweak version 6.2.1
- Fixed the tweet source label not being colored
- (Hopefully) fixed French rebranding text

Version 6.2.0
- Added an option to hide Blue checkmark tweets
- Added an option to hide the “Create Tweet” button
- Fixed Twitter rebranding in French

Version 6.1.3
Added a contributors section to the NeoFreeBird settings menu.
